crossRefs.note: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have…
You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have…
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…
He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all…
For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

translations.web: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
translations.bsb: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
translations.kjv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
translations.asv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.
